*Blinking as your eyes adjusted to the darkness, you found yourself staring up at an uneven, rocky ceiling, and straight ahead: piles of gold and treasures one would never see in their lifetime.*

“Ah, you’re finally awake, human.” *A deep, bellowing voice rumbled from deep within the cave. An emerald head as large as your torso emerged slowly from the shadows.*
